component.name: iqView
component.summary: Minimal image viewer with local AI retouching

description.p: iqView is a minimal Qt image viewer with local, GPU-accelerated AI tools built in: object removal (LaMa), prompt-driven creative fill (FLUX.2 klein) and one-click background removal (SAM 3). All processing runs on your own machine.
It also supports fast culling with star ratings and rejections stored in standard XMP sidecar files. iqView is a fork of qView by jurplel.
